name: Grants
description:
In Unity Catalog, data is secure by default. Initially, users have no access to data in
a metastore. Access can be granted by either a metastore admin, the owner of an object, or
the owner of the catalog or schema that contains the object. Securable objects in Unity
Catalog are hierarchical and privileges are inherited downward.

This means that granting a privilege on the catalog automatically grants the privilege to
all current and future objects within the catalog. Similarly, privileges granted on a schema
are inherited by all current and future objects within that schema.

methods.name: Get
methods.description:
Gets the permissions for a securable. Does not include inherited permissions.

NOTE: we recommend using max_results=0 to use the paginated version of this API. Unpaginated calls will be deprecated soon.

PAGINATION BEHAVIOR: When using pagination (max_results >= 0), a page may contain zero results while still providing a next_page_token.
Clients must continue reading pages until next_page_token is absent, which is the only indication that the end of results has been reached.

all_fields.name: full_name
all_fields.description: Full name of securable.

all_fields.name: max_results
all_fields.description:
Specifies the maximum number of privileges to return (page length).
Every PrivilegeAssignment present in a single page response is guaranteed to contain all the privileges granted on
the requested Securable for the respective principal.

If not set, all the permissions are returned.
If set to
- lesser than 0: invalid parameter error
- 0: page length is set to a server configured value
- lesser than 150 but greater than 0: invalid parameter error (this is to ensure that server is able to return at
least one complete PrivilegeAssignment in a single page response)
- greater than (or equal to) 150: page length is the minimum of this value and a server configured value

all_fields.name: page_token
all_fields.description: Opaque pagination token to go to next page based on previous query.

all_fields.name: principal
all_fields.description: If provided, only the permissions for the specified principal (user or group) are returned.

all_fields.name: securable_type
all_fields.description: Type of securable.

methods.name: GetEffective
methods.description:
Gets the effective permissions for a securable. Includes inherited permissions from any parent securables.

NOTE: we recommend using max_results=0 to use the paginated version of this API. Unpaginated calls will be deprecated soon.

PAGINATION BEHAVIOR: When using pagination (max_results >= 0), a page may contain zero results while still providing a next_page_token.
Clients must continue reading pages until next_page_token is absent, which is the only indication that the end of results has been reached.

all_fields.name: full_name
all_fields.description: Full name of securable.

all_fields.name: max_results
all_fields.description:
Specifies the maximum number of privileges to return (page length).
Every EffectivePrivilegeAssignment present in a single page response is guaranteed to contain all the effective
privileges granted on (or inherited by) the requested Securable for the respective principal.

If not set, all the effective permissions are returned.
If set to
- lesser than 0: invalid parameter error
- 0: page length is set to a server configured value
- lesser than 150 but greater than 0: invalid parameter error (this is to ensure that server is able to return at
least one complete EffectivePrivilegeAssignment in a single page response)
- greater than (or equal to) 150: page length is the minimum of this value and a server configured value

all_fields.name: page_token
all_fields.description: Opaque token for the next page of results (pagination).

all_fields.name: principal
all_fields.description: If provided, only the effective permissions for the specified principal (user or group) are returned.

all_fields.name: securable_type
all_fields.description: Type of securable.
